views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from the path entrance at the Duchess's clearing, looking along the path to the low crab-apple bough a few yards off, framed by the round gap of sky in the canopy
low-angle medium shot from the S-bend of the path looking back up at the low crab-apple bough against the halo of sky
eye-level wide shot from the fork in the path looking back west down the whole path toward the Duchess's clearing, sun slanting in through the trunks
eye-level medium shot from the S-bend of the path looking on toward the oak branch over the fork
eye-level close shot at the fork on the leaning fingerpost with its blank vine-scroll arms
low medium shot near the ground from under the crab-apple bough looking along the leaf-litter gap into the wood where the piglet trots off
low-angle close shot from the fork looking straight up at the oak branch where the Cat reappears and fades
high oblique wide shot from the path toward the March Hare looking back down at the fork, the fingerpost and the oak
eye-level detail along the smooth worn upper surface of the crab-apple limb, honeysuckle hanging from it

calibration_note_en: Coordinates re-read from the rendered image 2026-09-23. The crab-apple limb reaches north-east across the leaf litter beside the path, not across the path, so crab_apple_bough is the limb's middle, just north of the path. A second, wider leaf-litter track runs off to the north from the bough; it is recorded as pig_exit_gap. The fingerpost stands south-west of the fork.

checklist.camera_orthographic: near-nadir; tree trunks lean slightly outward at the frame edges (wide-lens perspective)
